title: repo_truth lists the dirty paths
intention: repo_truth reports which paths are dirty, not only how many, so a gate can tell one ticket's uncommitted build from another's.
why: Parent 316bdd5b5e62's lane (ruling 8t) must subtract the crossing ticket's own build from the tree's dirt, and the one repo-state instrument reported only a count. The paths are added to the instrument, not shelled from a second git (inspect_durability: 'the one instrument for repo state').
traces_to: Law 4 via ticket 316bdd5b5e62 (ruling 8t becomes a lane, and the lane needs the paths); the instrument stays the ONE instrument for repo state (transitions.py inspect_durability: 'never a second git shelled here'). RULE 1: the instrument's change lands at the instrument's own address.
how: (a) in repo_truth's per-repo loop, after the existing porcelain read, `_, z, _ = _git('status', '--porcelain', '-z', '--untracked-files=all')`. Caution: _git strips stdout, which can eat a leading space of the first entry's XY. Read it with a separate subprocess.run, unstripped, or parse without assuming column 3. (b) Split on '\0' and walk the fields. An entry's status is its first two chars and its path is entry[3:]. When status[0] in 'RC', consume the next field (the source) and skip it. (c) Add `"dirty": paths` to the row dict. (d) The proof file cairn/tools/orient/proofs/test_repo_truth_lists_dirty_paths.py, with PROVES keyed on this ticket, clauses 1-3, one tooth each, building its fixture with `git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t` in a tempfile.TemporaryDirectory. PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 120. Run only via bin/cairn test --netns.
falsifier: Done when cairn/tools/orient/proofs/test_repo_truth_lists_dirty_paths.py is green under bin/cairn test --netns. (1) A fixture git repo (git init plus one commit in a tempdir) with one modified tracked file, an untracked file in a new directory, and a staged `git mv` rename: repo_truth(repos=[Path(fixture)]) row `dirty` equals, as a set, {modified path, 'newdir/new.py', rename destination}. It holds no directory and no rename source. (2) The same row's `dirty_paths` equals the line count of `git -C fixture status --porcelain`. (3) A clean fixture repo gives `dirty == []` and `dirty_paths == 0`. Red at HEAD 4b3ac7f5: no `dirty` key. Horizon: this voyage.
